uploads.displayName: Good Boy: Better Pets 0.2.0 - MC 1.20.1 - Fabric
uploads.changelog:
Good Boy: Better Pets 0.2.0 — Minecraft 1.20.1, Fabric, Java 17

Initial standalone release. Pet your owned dogs, cats and kittens with an empty main hand using G. Rebind petting to a keyboard key or mouse button in Minecraft Controls or Client visuals > Petting key; Escape unbinds it and hides the prompt.

Original animations fitted to vanilla models: cat stretching, kneading biscuits and chest grooming; dog digging and head/ear reactions. Petting includes eye expressions and sounds from the animal, with first-person hands and third-person observers. Paw-to-face grooming has been removed.

Calm cats act every 3–6 minutes; adult dogs attempt a dig every 10–20 minutes. Dog digging removes one safe exposed eligible block, plays block-specific sounds and can occasionally find a bonus item. Owner preferences and administrator world rules control digging and idle behavior; client visual settings are separate.

Install this exact Minecraft/loader build on the server and participating clients. SeamlessLib is not required or bundled. Requires Fabric API 0.92.12+1.20.1. Mod Menu is optional.

Digging honors mobGriefing, spawn protection, native cancellation and the tested protection adapters. Other claim systems require verified adapters. Optional renderer/protection combinations and exact tested builds are listed in the repository acceptance documentation. Unsupported custom rigs or eye layouts can fall back; affected visuals can be disabled.

Local acceptance covers packaged singleplayer, two clients, late tracking, reconnects, save/restart, keybinding persistence, animation/UI captures and recorded optional integrations. Software-rendered tests do not establish compatibility with every hardware driver; silent audio tests verify event routing and engine playback. 

Source and detailed acceptance: https://github.com/DerkOttersberg/seamless-dogs/tree/1.20.1
All Rights Reserved.
